# Forms

How a form takes and checks what someone types: which host it lives in, when to validate, what a blocked submit does, how required and optional are marked, and what happens on leaving with edits.

**Kind:** Pattern

**Storybook page:** `design-system/src/storybook-docs/patterns/Forms/Forms.mdx`

## The hosts

A form lives in one of four hosts. The Form template draws each; this pattern says which to pick and how the form behaves inside it.

- **In a page.** Settings and anything saved as a group. Buttons left-aligned under the fields.
- **In a Panel.** A short edit from a table, with the page in view. Cancel and Save full bleed at the bottom.
- **In a Modal.** A rare, critical task with fewer than five fields. 8-col; a confirm is 4-col or 6-col.
- **In steps.** A long task on Frame · focused: steps down the left side when there are five or more.

## Usage

Use Forms when a page asks for input that is saved together: adding a student, logging a session, a reflection, profile settings. Ask only what is needed, group fields under a `Fieldset` legend of two or three words, keep one column except for pairs that belong together (first and last name, date and time), and reveal a conditional field under the answer that needs it rather than adding a separate one.

| The form… | Host | Buttons |
| --- | --- | --- |
| is saved as a group on its own page: settings, a profile | In a page | Left-aligned under the fields, Primary first, Cancel Subtle |
| is a short edit of a row, with the page still in view | In a Panel · Details | Cancel and Save full bleed at the bottom |
| is rare and critical, with fewer than five fields | In a Modal, 8-col | Cancel (Default) and the action, full bleed |
| is long, or has sections someone works through | In steps on Frame · focused | Cancel (Subtle) left; Back and Next full bleed right |
| asks for one value read far more than changed | Inline edit on the record | None; it saves on its own |

## Alternatives

- For one value on a record page, use `InlineEdit`; it saves on its own.
- For a setting that applies at once, use `Toggle`; it never waits for Save.
- For a filter, follow Filtering: filters are not a form.
- For a decision with no fields, use Modal · Active.

## Content guidelines

| Do | Don't |
| --- | --- |
| Label names the field: "School email". | Label gives an instruction: "Enter your school email:". |
| Error says what to fix: "Enter a full email, like name@school.org". | "Invalid input", "Error 422". |
| Caption says what the field is for: "Shared with the supervisor". | Caption repeats the label. |
| Placeholder shows a good answer: "name@school.org". | Placeholder names the control: "Text field". |
| Submit names the outcome: "Log session", "Add student". | "Submit", "Save" when the outcome has a name. |
| Dates and times as the person reads them: "Mar 4, 2026 · 4:00 PM". | "2026-03-04T16:00". |

## Accessibility

- Every input has a visible label. A group is a `fieldset` with a `legend`; its one error is announced once.
- A field error is announced and sets `aria-invalid`; the submit moves focus to the first invalid field. A server message is announced when it appears.
- A required field sets `aria-required`; the asterisk is explained in the legend and never carries the meaning alone.
- A sending button keeps its name and sets `aria-busy`; Cancel stays reachable.
- A dialog opens only from a person's action. Focus goes to the first input and stays trapped until it closes.

## Parts

| Part | Component | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Fields | Form template | There is no Form component: a Fieldset groups the fields inside a host. |
| Rejection at the top | `SectionMessage` | A danger message, scrolled into view. |
| Choices | `RadioGroup`, `Select`, `DatePicker` | A control that cannot be wrong. |
| Hosts | Section, Panel, Modal, Frame | Page, Panel, Modal and steps. |
| Confirm view | Modal | Swapped in place today. A confirm view prop is Planned. |

## Motion

Forms reads these motion tokens and no literal duration or curve.

| Event | Transition | Tokens | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| focus | Update a value or state | `--ds-motion-appearance-fast` | Border color on appearance.fast. The focus ring never animates. |
| error | Call attention | `--ds-motion-spatial-fast` · `--ds-motion-appearance-fast` | An error on leaving a field makes room on spatial.fast, then fades in; it fades and the room closes once the field is fixed. |
| blocked | Call attention | `--ds-motion-spatial-fast` | A blocked submit shakes the Modal, or the field with its own button, once. Never bigger on repeat; never in Reduced mode. |
| failed | Call attention | `--ds-motion-spatial-fast` · `--ds-motion-appearance-fast` | When the system failed, a message makes room at the top of the Modal or form, then fades in. No shake: the person did nothing wrong. A page-level error is a one-line summary that makes room at the top; focus goes to the first error. |
| steps | Step to the next or previous | `--ds-motion-appearance-fast` | Step states change in place. |
| saving | Update a value or state | `--ds-motion-appearance-fast` | The button keeps its width: its label fades out, a Spinner fades in, and the same button confirms when done. |

## Best practices

### Validate a field when it loses focus and clear the error once the rule is met. {#validate-a-field-when-it-loses-focus-and-clear-the-error-once-the-rule-is-met}

**Checked:** Automatic

The error shows on the field, says what to fix, and goes away as soon as the value passes. Nothing is checked while typing. A warning accepts the value; a field is invalid only when the form cannot go on.

### Keep the submit button enabled and let it show what is missing. {#keep-the-submit-button-enabled-and-let-it-show-what-is-missing}

**Checked:** Automatic

A disabled submit gives no direction and leaves the tab order. Pressing it marks every missing field and moves focus to the first; the body scrolls to it. The button disables only while sending, when it swaps its label for a spinner in place and keeps its width.

### Keep a blocked submit in the same Modal. {#keep-a-blocked-submit-in-the-same-modal}

**Checked:** Automatic

Mark the field, say what to fix inline, scroll the body to it, shake once. Never a second dialog for the error. Reduced motion drops the shake; the color, icon, message and focus move carry it. A server failure: Errors.

Do: The message under the field, in the same Modal.
Don't: A second dialog over the first, with the field left unexplained.

### Mark required fields with an asterisk and explain it once. {#mark-required-fields-with-an-asterisk-and-explain-it-once}

**Checked:** Automatic

The legend says what the asterisk means. Optional fields are marked "(optional)" only in a form where most fields are required, so one pattern holds across the product. `isRequired` sets the mark and `aria-required`.

### Put help in the caption, never in a tooltip. {#put-help-in-the-caption-never-in-a-tooltip}

**Checked:** Automatic

A caption stays after the person types and is read by a screen reader with the field. A tooltip never carries the only copy of anything. An explanation most people will never need opens from an `InlineMessage` beside the field.

Do: Help in the caption, where it stays after typing.
Don't: Help only in a tooltip: gone on touch, gone after typing.

### Ask before leaving with unsaved edits. {#ask-before-leaving-with-unsaved-edits}

**Checked:** Automatic

Close, Cancel and navigating away raise a 4-col Modal: Back returns without losing anything typed; Discard is Danger. A form already in a Modal asks in that Modal's confirm view, so two layers never become three. A confirm view prop on the Modal is Planned . A form with no edits leaves at once. In a focused task, Close and Cancel play the opening backwards once the person confirms.

### Prefer a bound input to a free one. {#prefer-a-bound-input-to-a-free-one}

**Checked:** Review

Up to five choices: `RadioGroup` or checkboxes, visible at once. Six or more: `Select`. A date: `DatePicker`. A number: min and max. A radio group starts unanswered and never falls back to its first option. A `Toggle` applies at once, so anything that waits for Save is a `Checkbox`.

### Give the form a title from its host and a legend for each group. {#give-the-form-a-title-from-its-host-and-a-legend-for-each-group}

**Checked:** Review

The form's title is the page, Panel or Modal heading. Groups take a `Fieldset` legend, two or three words, a noun phrase. Labels are sentence case, one to three words, naming the field rather than what to do.

### Set autofill on every field the browser can fill. {#set-autofill-on-every-field-the-browser-can-fill}

**Checked:** Automatic

`autoComplete` on name, email, phone and address fields. Prefill what is already known, such as the student picked from a row.
